Source checkout: 63e07b4f22240790818a0d884cb634e3b2a90054 (local changes recorded in asset_manifest.json)

NNModels.py is byte-identical to the existing adapter in LfD_sim. That adapter
replaces the upstream common_header wildcard import with the Torch imports
needed to unpickle the saved network classes. No further adaptation was made.

Checkpoint files are provisioned locally under ignored data/ and are not
included in this Git repository. The historical permission note in LfD_sim
refers to its Sine bundle; it does not document redistribution permission for
Worm or Five_Obstacle_DS weights.
